prog='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter
    cnt = Counter(x for row in grid for x in row if x)
    (A, _), (B, _) = cnt.most_common(2)

        rs = [i for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if grid[i][j] == c]

    return out
'''
